Forum Café in Tirol

** Welcome to **Forum Café**, your cozy retreat in the heart of **Tirol**! Nestled in the charming town of **Innsbruck**, this beloved café invites you to savor the finest local flavors while enjoying the breathtaking Alpine scenery. Indulge in our signature **Kaiserschmarrn**—fluffy, caramelized, and dusted with powdered sugar—paired with a steaming cup of **Tiroler Bergkäse** latte. For a hearty bite, try our **Schlutzkrapfen** or a warm **Kaspressknödel**, made with the freshest ingredients from the region. Whether you're planning a day trip to the **Nordkette** or exploring the historic **Altstadt**, **Forum Café** is the perfect spot to refuel. Our terrace offers a panoramic view of the **Inn River** and the majestic **Nordkette**, making every visit unforgettable. Come experience the warmth of **Tirol**’s hospitality—one delicious bite at a time!
